name: Lesencefalu (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of blue, yellow and green in the ratio 6:1:3, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Lesencefalu: a blue and green shield with a white church and a bunch of grapes, bordered in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
